critical_rules_cases: Attack trigger cast occurs during resolution, not free, one selected spell per trigger, unchosen exiles stranded without another permission; exiled lands cannot be played via cast-spell permission.
Removal of Nathan after attack but before his triggered ability resolves leaves trigger on stack but removes his static off-color mana spending ability.

Fire Nation Palace can grant firebending before combat; mana attack trigger must resolve before Nathan's spell-cast to pay, lasts during combat; mana with Nathan on board can pay off-color stolen spells.
Thieving Varmint tap/pay-life ability only pays for non-owned spells and requires tap eligibility; Dark Ritual produces BBB, cannot itself satisfy commander U/R pips.
Roaming Throne Rogue repeats Nathan attack trigger; each independent trigger may cast one separately paid spell.
Firebender Ascension copies relevant attack-caused trigger only after quest-counter requirement; Fire Lord Azula copies spells cast while attacking and those copies are not cast.
Karlach grants extra combat if first combat attack conditions met; Nathan must survive and actually attack again.
Dolmen Gate prevents combat damage to attacking creatures but not removal or blockers preventing player combat damage; attack trigger does not require connection.
Cast-from-exile triggers from Passionate Archaeologist, Nalfeshnee and Wild-Magic Sorcerer distinguish real spell casts from spell copies.
Commander third-turn UBR and T4 open-mana casting are not captured by static source-presence probability.
Drannith Magistrate and Rule of Law impede exile-cast permissions; opponent interaction and timing matter.
